description:
About Us 

 Dorsia is an AI-native hospitality-tech company redefining access to the world's most coveted tables, events, and cultural moments. We give our members exclusive access and our operators unmatched control, visibility, and revenue.

 We don't just provide access, we create it. Dorsia owns its luxury experiential events end-to-end, from the guest list to production and the technology behind every entrance. Through our enterprise platform, we're building the infrastructure layer for the future of hospitality, powering leading hotels and private member clubs with the same systems that run Dorsia.

 We grew 480% in 2025 and today we operate across 400+ venues in 26 cities with revenue engines spanning consumer and enterprise membership, Dorsia Pay, the Culture Calendar, and our enterprise platform.

 Backed by $54M from Index Ventures, Invus, Red Sea Ventures, Major Food Group, and MoonPay,  we're scaling into our most consequential phase of growth. We're adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that's where you come in.

 About the Role 

 Dorsia is seeking a Payments Engineer to own the entire financial layer of our platform. This spans member dining payments, billing and renewals, dining credits and redemptions, operator reconciliation, and corporate account management for our B2B products. Dorsia Pay, our proprietary frictionless dining product, is the most visible expression of this work, but it is one surface of many.

 Qualified individuals have proven experience building payments infrastructure in production and understand the full lifecycle of a transaction. You have worked with the hospitality or restaurant tech ecosystem and understand firsthand the nuances of POS integration and operations-facing systems. 

 What You'll Do 

 Payments Infrastructure 

 
 Own the core payments infrastructure that supports every financial transaction on the Dorsia platform, from member-facing dining payments to billing and corporate accounts.

 Design and maintain payment processing architecture and build integrations with payment processors, acquirers, and card networks.

 Own the membership billing lifecycle including recurring charges, failed payment recovery, and cancellation flows.

 Support corporate and B2B billing surfaces that sit alongside the consumer product.

 Implement and maintain PCI-compliant data handling practices across all payments.

 
 Restaurant and Operator Integrations 

 
 Own integrations with POS systems and restaurant technology platforms including SevenRooms, Toast, and Square.

 Build robust, fault-tolerant integration layers that account for the operational realities of restaurant systems in production.

 Design operator-side reconciliation and payout flows, as well as integration architecture that scales to new venues and markets smoothly.

 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

 
 Work with the Finance team on reconciliation, reporting, and the downstream workflows that depend on accurate transaction data.

 Collaborate with the Security Engineering team on fraud controls, access patterns, and the security posture of the financial layer.

 Partner with the Product team to shape how payments experiences evolve across the member app, operator tools, and overall marketplace.

 
 The Winning Recipe 

 
 Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

 5+ years of backend engineering experience with at least 2 years focused on payments systems in production.

 Hands-on experience with payment processors and thorough understanding of authorization, capture, settlement, and reconciliation end-to-end.

 Experience building subscription or membership billing systems, including failure recovery and lifecycle management.

 Prior experience integrating with POS or restaurant technology platforms.

 Working knowledge of PCI-DSS compliance requirements.

 Clear, direct communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across finance, operations, and restaurant operators.

 Ability to work in a fast-paced, complex environment involving cross-functional projects.

 A genuine interest in the Dorsia product, the member experience, and what it means to build for hospitality at this level.

 
 Compensation and Benefits 

 
 Flexible PTO

 Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 FSA

 Commuter benefits

 Free membership to One Medical

 Teladoc

 Talkspace

 Kindbody

 401(k)

 In-office lunch 3 days a week

 Employee Dining Credits

 
 Salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and stage. We determine our pay by considering skills and experience related to the role, location, and ensuring internal equity relative to other Dorsia employees.
 Compensation: 

 New York Pay Range
 $165,000 — $185,000 USD 


 Workplace Philosophy at Dorsia 

 At Dorsia, we believe that culture eats strategy. The best ideas in the world mean nothing without the right people around the table and the right chemistry between them. We are, unapologetically, a people-first organization. 

 In-Person Matters 

 We’re creating once-in-a-lifetime experiences for the most discerning audience in the world. That doesn’t happen over Zoom. It happens through collisions: a spark across a desk, a kitchen-side conversation that unlocks a partnership, the energy of ideas felt, not typed. That’s why in-office culture is non-negotiable at Dorsia. 

 Who We Hire 

 We don’t subscribe to check-the-box hiring. We hire for merit and mindset, which naturally creates a team with varied backgrounds. What unites us isn’t demographics, it’s a shared vision: to build the social operating system for the cultural vanguard.

 Lifestyle Hours 

 We’re not a 9-to-5 company. Our lifestyle mirrors our members. Early flights, after-work events, and late-night sprints when the work demands it. But we love what we do, and we definitely love a good party.

 High Performance Culture 

 Working at Dorsia isn’t for everyone—and that’s the point. Our culture is designed for builders, not passengers. We move fast, set ambitious standards, and expect people to rise to them. If you have the talent and the drive, this will be a ride to remember.

 A Final Word 

 We’re building something special. It will take long hours and relentless effort. It’s not for everyone. For those with the metabolism, you’ll create something that changes how culture is lived. And that’s the kind of work worth your life’s energy.
